items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Like, that's where I first saw Sammy Davis with the Will Mastin Trio

ctx.x: But was it really that big?

Well, it wasn't that big, because they didn't run a consistent policy. When I came out here, they would just bring in an act occasionally. Like, that's where I first saw Sammy Davis with the Will Mastin Trio, and they were living down at the Morris Hotel down on Fifth Street during that time -- right west of Central Avenue. And I saw several acts in there. But it wasn't as big like the Apollo in New York.

They also had another theatre down on 43rd and Central called the Bill Robinson Theatre, with the greatest seats I ever sat in in a theatre -- in this little theatre, you know. They had loge seats where you'd just sink into them, you know... [LAUGHS]
